vadsrijk.z5droom.fase2.onder: Stand on the pink clouds. Soon: the lullaby
vadsrijk.z5droom.fase3.onder: Stand in the yellow circle until the hum meter is full
vadsrijk.z5droom.getroost.onder: The dream listens: 8 s still and +50% damage
vadsrijk.z5droom.nachtmerrie.onder: Too late: the backwards song wins for now
vadsrijk.z5droom.neurie_eerst: The dream is too heavy: hum together in the yellow circle first!
vadsrijk.z5droom.omkeer: The dream flips over! Only the pink clouds are safe.
vadsrijk.z5droom.praat.achterstevoren: Ybab eyb-a-kcor... they're singing it backwards...
vadsrijk.z5droom.praat.blij: What a lovely dream... thank you, little knight.
vadsrijk.z5droom.praat.fase2: Everything is gray... everything is heavy... where is my song?
vadsrijk.z5droom.praat.fase3: I... I hear something. Softly. Hum it again?
vadsrijk.z5droom.praat.neurie: Mmmmm... I know that song. My mama used to sing it.
vadsrijk.z5droom.ranken: Gray tendrils are growing out of the cloud! Smash them.
vadsrijk.z5droom.vangnet: A dream cloud catches you and puts you back.
vadsrijk.z5droom.wakker.onder: Mother Cloudwhale is sleeping sweetly again
vadsrijk.z5droom.wiegelied.luister: Listen! The notes light up in the RIGHT order...
vadsrijk.z5droom.wiegelied.nu: Your turn! Right-click the %s notes in the same order.
vadsrijk.z5droom.wiegelied.vals: Off-key! Start again from the first note.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.ambacht.binnenkort: The workshops of the Crafters' Guild open soon. Come back then!
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.ambacht.gilde: The Crafters' Guild teaches you the Masterworks of nine professions. The doors open soon. Until then: practice in the workshops of your own town.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.bevelbrief: In Cadet Tuft's locker: 'Leave the back door of the Council Hall open tonight. The High Council.' Below it, a stamp: a round paw with little pads. Guhs don't have pads.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.gevonden: New clue in your Detective's Notebook: %s (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.haren: On the lectern in the Council Hall lie long, silver-gray hairs. Not guh fluff: that's shorter and curlier.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.kaastest: Chancellor Softpelt turned down the soup ('too warm, too... shared'), but snatched the piece of ripe cheese right out of your paw. His whiskers quivered and his monocle fogged up.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.kaasvoorraad: Cook Ladle: every night, cheese disappears from the pantry. Only cheese. No guh eats that much cheese.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.liedje: General Downfeather wasn't in the barracks at night: he was secretly practicing a birthday song for the Queen. His coat is snow-white, not gray.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.logboek: In the Skyport logbook: every Thursday night a quiet little boat leaves for the east, across the Cloud Sea. Booked by 'S.P.'. No name, just letters.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.soepkom: Cadet Tuft got the notes in the Great Soup Kitchen, under his soup bowl. They promised that his family could come over from the east.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.staart: Skinny Minnie saw a posh guh in a long cape sneaking out of the pantry at night. Under the cape swished a long, gray tail.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.theevlek: Councilor Inkblot spilled tea on page twelve and didn't dare say so. She never touched the torn page. The spare key to the archive is kept at the Chancellery.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bewijs.zegel: Councilor Goldthread flies to his mother in Lanternhaven every week, under his own name. But the S.P. booking bears the seal of the Chancellery. Only one guh uses that seal.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bloesem.water: You water the blossom tree. Pink petals flutter down all over you.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bol.gevonden: A little ball of pink wool! (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bord.fout: Inspector Snoop shakes his head. "No, no. Look at the evidence: %s"
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bord.juist.0: You point at Chancellor Softpelt. The Council Hall goes quiet. Very quiet.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bord.juist.1: "Me? Me? But I always hand out cookies!" His tail swishes under his cape. Everyone sees it.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bord.nog_niet: Not enough evidence yet to point at anyone. Keep sleuthing!
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.bord.zeker: Three clues point the same way: a tail, the Chancellery seal, and a soft spot for ripe cheese.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.brief.0: In the drawer of Silvertail's desk lies a gray envelope with a seal: a ring.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.brief.1: "To the Ring Finger, Duchess Ringaling, The Star-Snuffing Tower, the Silklands. Madam. The whale is nearly ripe. The little lantern is yours. Your servant, S."
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.brief.2: On the back, in different handwriting, very small: "Excellent. I want ALL the lanterns. - R."
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.finale.wacht: Pinkie Silvertail has jumped into the blowhole. Jump in after him, into The Cloudwhale Dream!
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.flap.gevonden: Behind the statue sits a gray plush bunny with one ear. Flop!
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.oog.gemeten: You look through the telescope. The Eye fills the lens: gray, round, and it's looking... back. Twelve inches.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.roosvenster: The light through the rose window falls over you in every color. Even in colors that don't have a name yet.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.aankomst.oog: Mother Cloudwhale opens her eye and looks at you. She smiles. When a whale smiles, you feel it in your tummy.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.aankomst.stad: Over the edge of her back: towers, banners, lanterns and a cathedral with a gate reaching up into the clouds. Highchonk!
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.aankomst.welkom: Welcome to Highchonk! Report to Harbormaster Weathervane at the Skyport desk.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.aankomst.zee: The airship rises from the Liftoff Pier. Above you hangs a head as big as a mountain. With eyelashes.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.cliff.0: In the east, beyond the Cloud Sea, lies a pink strip of land. Above it, five stars hang low in the sky.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.cliff.1: As you watch, one goes out. Poof. As if someone blew it out. Four are left.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.cliff.2: Next to the snuffed star, something glitters. Ten little rings. On ten toes.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.cliff.3: A voice over the clouds, sweet as syrup: "What pretty stars. I want those. All of them."
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.droom.0: You jump into the blowhole. Warm mist, soft as down. You sink down, into the whale, into her dream.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.droom.1: Pinkie Silvertail sings the lullaby backwards. His tail swishes to the beat. The clouds turn gray.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.droom.2: He trips over his own tail. Poof. The Cloudwatch jumps in after you and puts him in a cloud cage.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.droom.3: But the dream stays gray: a big gray whale made of mist swims in circles, crying softly.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.droom.4: You take the page and sing the lullaby. The right way around. Off-key. But with all your heart.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.droom.5: The gray whale stops crying. It turns pink, from its tail to its nose. The dream becomes a lovely dream.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.herinnering.0: Graycourt. Everything is gray. The streets, the sky, the guhs. On every wall a poster: "SHARING IS DUMB".
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.herinnering.1: Mikas walk past with sacks full of gray fluff. Nobody looks up. Looking is dangerous.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.herinnering.2: Minnie ties an old lantern kite to her back. She runs up the Toll Bridge. The wind catches her.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.herinnering.3: Below her: the gray lands, the humming Chonk Pipes, all heading east. Above her: one pink dot. Highchonk.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.herinnering.4: "I flew for three days. Then I smelled soup."
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.ontmasker.0: Inspector Snoop tugs at the cape. Out comes a zipper. A ZIPPER. In a guh.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.ontmasker.1: The guh suit slumps to the floor. There stands a skinny, silver-gray Mika with a monocle and a tail as long as a scarf.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.ontmasker.2: "Pinkie Silvertail, at your service. Of the Ring Finger. My colleague the Kite Catcher got to swipe the lanterns from the coast. I get the biggest little lantern of all: this whale. City and all."
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.ontmasker.3: "And I'm taking this page with me!" He leaps through the window, over the rooftops, to the blowhole!
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.ontmasker.onder: Pinkie Silvertail, of the Ring Finger
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.ontwaken.0: You sing. The eye beneath the balcony slowly opens. Blue, with eyelashes as long as trees.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.scene.ontwaken.1: Mother Cloudwhale blows a plume of cloud from all three of her blowholes. All of Highchonk cheers.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.schat.ooggaarde: Beneath the balcony of the Eye Garden, between the whale's eyelashes, a chest gleams. She doesn't blink. Phew.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.schat.staartvin: All the way at the back, where Mother Cloudwhale's tail curls up, a chest is tied tight. Nobody dares go that high.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.schat.troonzaal: Behind the Queen's throne stands a chest marked 'DO NOT OPEN'. Inside is a note: 'Except knights.'
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.soep.al: This Unchonked guh already has a bowl. She smiles at you with soup on her snout.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.soep.kom: You ladle out a bowl of soup. It steams pink. "Thank you..." (%s/4)
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.spuitgat.adem: A soft sigh comes out of the blowhole. Like a pillow being fluffed.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verdachte.donsveer: General Downfeather, the commander. The mole is in his Cloudwatch, and at night he's nowhere to be found.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verdachte.gouddraad: Councilor Goldthread, the treasurer. Often flies off in secret.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verdachte.inktvlek: Councilor Inkblot, the archivist. Has the key to the old books.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verdachte.zachtpels: Chancellor Softpelt, the Queen's right hand. Always sweet, always cookies.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.donsveer.antw: Tuft? That kid can't even salute without dropping his helmet. A mole? Hmpf. A mouse, at most.
GRAY? My coat is SNOW-WHITE. Look. Here. It's as white as a fresh cloud. Gray. Pff.
I was practicing. A song. For the Queen's birthday. On the roof of the tower, where nobody can hear it.
I sing off-key. Very off-key. But with all my heart. Don't tell anyone. Hmpf.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.donsveer.intr: Hmpf. A knight. In my tower. I'm busy.
General, there's a mole in your Cloudwatch. And you weren't in the barracks last night.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.donsveer.vraa: Did you know about Cadet Tuft?
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.gouddraad.ant: In secret? I fly to my mother. In Lanternhaven. Every week. She's old and she bakes the yummiest lantern cookies.
I don't tell the Council, because then they'd call me a mama's boy. Which I am. Proudly.
S.P.? I always book under my own name. G-O-L-D-T-H-R-E-A-D. With three D's. Well, two.
Let me see. Hmm. That booking has the Chancellery seal. The little crown with the feather. Only the Chancellor uses that.
But the Chancellor... he's so nice, isn't he? He gives everyone cookies.
Gold, silver and mostly candy. A treasurer needs something tasty to count too.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.gouddraad.int: An interrogation? Of ME? The treasurer of the High Council? Hmpf. Ask away. Quickly. I still have buttons to count.
You often fly off at night. Where to?
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.gouddraad.vra: Why do you fly off in secret?
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.inktvlek.antw: The oldest story of the Order. About a cat at the edge of the world who never had enough.
And on the back... Mother Cloudwhale's lullaby. Whoever sings it backwards gives her a gray dream. That's why it was kept under lock and key.
I... okay. Okay! I spilled tea. On page twelve. Of the Great Snuggle Book. A stain as big as a cookie.
I didn't dare say so. But I never touched the torn page. Really, I didn't.
And the key? I have one. The spare key is kept at the Chancellery. Always has been.
Here. Among the books. I sleep in the reading chair. The books like the company.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.inktvlek.intr: Shhh! Whispers only in the archive. The books are sleeping. What brings you here?
The torn page was stolen from the Council Hall. You have the key.
Stolen? Oh no. Oh no, oh no. Ask whatever you like. Quietly.
Everyone! Refugees, cadets, councilors. The Chancellor often comes by to watch. Sweet of him. Though he never eats a thing.
Cheese. Every night. Only cheese! No bread, no soup, no cookies. Only the ripest, stinkiest cheese.
No guh eats that much cheese. The pantry hatch squeaks when someone opens it. Minnie sleeps right next to it.
So big that a cadet fell in last week. He swam happy little laps in it. After that I put a lid on it.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.kok.intro.0: A knight in my kitchen! Soup? Of course you want soup. Everyone wants soup.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.kok.intro.1: Yes please. And I have a few questions. About what happens in the soup kitchen at night.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.kok.vraag.0: Who all comes to eat here?
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.kok.vraag.1: Do you ever find anything missing?
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.kok.vraag.2: How big is that pot, anyway?
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.mientje.antwo: Yes. A posh guh in a long cape. He snuck out of the pantry with his arms full of cheese.
And under his cape... a tail was swishing. A long, gray tail. Guhs don't have tails. Right?
I didn't say anything. In the east you learn to be quiet.
That's a long story. I'll tell you later. If you want to listen. Nobody has asked yet.
Better and better. My cheeks are turning pink. Look. A little.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.mientje.intro: You handed out soup. To Graysie and Dusty and Marl and Pebble. I saw it. You're kind.
Cook Ladle says you sleep next to the pantry at night.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.mientje.vraag: Did you see anyone at night?
How did you escape from the east?
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.nog_niet: You have nothing to ask this councilor about yet. Follow Inspector Snoop's trail first.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.plukje.antwoo: I don't know! It said 'The High Council' at the bottom. So I thought it was allowed. The Council is everyone's boss.
My family still lives in the east. In the gray. The first note said they could come over. If I listened well.
I wanted to see them again so badly...
In the Great Soup Kitchen! I eat soup there every evening. And then there'd be a note under my bowl. I never saw who put it there.
I'm so sorry. I'll report to Captain Springfeather myself later.
Cadet Tuft. There was a command note in your locker. 'Leave the back door of the Council Hall open.'
...My helmet's slipping over my eyes again. Then I don't have to look at you.
Nobody's angry. I just want to know what happened.
How did you get the notes?
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.zachtpels.ant: Soup? No, no, thank you. Too warm. Too... shared.
But is that... ripe cheese? Mmm. May I? Just a taste. To be polite.
(He snatches the cheese out of your paw. His whiskers quiver. His monocle fogs up.)
Ahem. Delicious. I mean: ordinary. Ordinary cheese. Where were we?
Here, of course. Writing letters. To... friends. Distant friends. Very distant friends.
The Chancellery. So, me. But it's safe in my drawer. Look, right here... hm. Strange. It's not there.
Someone must have stolen it! How awful. What treachery. Cookie?
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.zachtpels.int: The brave knight! In my Chancellery! What an honor. A cookie? Have a seat. Not on that chair, my cape is sitting there.
I have a few questions, Chancellor. And I brought something from the Great Soup Kitchen.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.verhoor.zachtpels.vra: Offer him a bowl of soup and a piece of ripe cheese
Who has the spare key to the archive?
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.vitrine.z5_pluisninja: In the display case lie two teeny-tiny fluff daggers, as soft as a cotton swab. 'The Fluff Daggers. Weapon of the Fluff Ninja.'
Below it, very small, almost invisible: 'Coming soon.'
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.vitrine.z5_vadszanger: In the glass display case lies a pink guh flute on a little cushion. The sign says: 'The Guh Flute. Weapon of the Chonk Singer.'
Below it, in fancy letters: 'Coming soon.'
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.zachtpels.karton: This is a cardboard Chancellor. The Cloudwatch put it here so the tourists don't get a fright. There's a cookie hanging from it.
vadsrijk.z5verhaal.zone5.klaar: Highchonk is saved! Queen Gentleheart names you Knight of Highchonk. Tail Park is blooming, and the Unchonked sing along.
vadsrijk.z5wereld.vangnet: A soft little cloud catches you and sets you back on Mother Cloudwhale.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.db.blij: Hee hee hee... it tickles... I'm pink again!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.db.fase3.onder: He sucks in more often and strikes double lightning
vadsrijk.z5wezens.db.kussen: He's going to suck you in! Jump onto a pink cloud pillow!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.db.slag_mis: Not enough of you in the yellow circle!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.gz.alles_dicht: No hot air, no whale! Everything SHUT!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.gz.fase3.onder: Turn at least three back open
vadsrijk.z5wezens.gz.klep_open: This valve is open. Well done!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.gz.klep_weer_open: Hot air is flowing again! (%s still shut)
vadsrijk.z5wezens.gz.kleppen_eerst: He's too tough like this: turn the valves open first!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.gz.weg: My valves... this goes in my report!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.buik_in: You climb down through the maintenance hatch... The Belly Tunnels.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.buik_uit: You climb back up to the cellar of the Soup Kitchen.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.hint.buik_in: A maintenance hatch (right-click): to the Belly Tunnels
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.hint.noordvin_af: Cloud lift to the north fin (right-click)
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.hint.staart_af: Cloud lift to the tail fin (right-click)
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.hint.zuidvin_af: Cloud lift to the south fin (right-click)
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.nest_in: Behind the loose plank... a secret Mika nest!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.nest_uit: You slip back into the Skyport.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.noordvin_af: The cloud lift sinks down to the north fin.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.noordvin_op: The cloud lift takes you back to the city.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.staart_af: The cloud lift sinks down to the tail fin.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.staart_op: The cloud lift takes you back to Tail Park.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.zuidvin_af: The cloud lift sinks down to the south fin.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.luik.zuidvin_op: The cloud lift takes you back to the city.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.mika.weg.1: The Ring Finger will hear about this!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.set.6: (6) Cloud Pillow: below 30% Chonk a cloud catches you (Snuggle Shield 20% of your max Chonk, 6 s; 1x per 45 s)
vadsrijk.z5wezens.sparren.bezet: This knight is already sparring with someone else.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.sparren.eerst_klikken: Right-click the knight first to spar.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.sparren.gewonnen: ✦ Well fought! The knight bows. (Trial Tokens: %s)
vadsrijk.z5wezens.sparren.start: On your marks... get set... spar! (dodge the red strip, don't hit the pink shield)
vadsrijk.z5wezens.sparren.verloren.klapp: Three pillow bonks: the knight wins this round. Practice a little more!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.tip.bezeten_oefenpop: That training dummy moved! Gray fluff has crept inside it. Red circle = it spins around: step away. Beat it and the fluff blows right out.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.tip.grauwe_pluismijt: They nibble at the whale. Small and fast: hits that strike several mites at once work best.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.tip.grauwe_wolkduivel: A red stripe under you = he's diving. Step aside!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.tip.mika_harpoenier: Red line = his harpoon. If it hits you, he pulls you toward him.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.tip.mika_lontlegger: He keeps his distance and throws cheese bombs (red circle). Run up to him: up close, he runs away.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.tip.mika_saboteur: Red circle = that's where he throws a gas wrench. Stay out of the gray cloud, it makes you sticky.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.tip.mistslier: Gray circle = mist. Anyone who stays in it can barely see and gets sticky. Walk out of it.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.tip.sparringridder: The knight swings a pillow along the red strip: step out of it. Pink sparkle on his shield = he's blocking, wait a moment. Three pillow bonks and you lose (it doesn't hurt).
vadsrijk.z5wezens.tip.vermomde_mika: Not every Cloud Watcher is real! A red circle behind you = he appears there. Step away.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.vangnet: A little cloud catches you! Phew.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.zs.betrapt: How... how did you see that?!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.zs.fase2.onder: Which Cloud Watcher is him? Look for the silver glint
vadsrijk.z5wezens.zs.fase3.onder: Turn the gray gas valves shut
vadsrijk.z5wezens.zs.gevonden: Found him! He's off balance for a moment: +50% damage!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.zs.ontsnap: Enough! I'm flying off through the blowhole, and the whale goes gray!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.zs.ventielen_eerst: He's holding on tight: turn the gray gas valves shut first!
vadsrijk.z5wezens.zs.vermom: Find me if you can, knight. I am everyone and no one.
vadsrijk.z5wezens.zs.weg: The Ring Finger... will... not be pleased...
vadsrijk.z5wezens.zs.welke: Five Cloud Watchers... which one is him? (silver glint by the tail)
